title: Information Architecture: Navigation Hub, Route Map & Workspace Quick-Switch
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: Define a single information architecture for the Redwood Console that reduces cognitive load across dashboards, rollouts, and cost views. Deliverables include: a navigation hub pattern (primary + contextual navigation), a canonical route map (URLs, route params, and fallbacks), and a lightweight workspace quick-switcher prototype that supports cross-workspace search and keyboard shortcuts. Goals: reduce clicks to common tasks, make rollouts & cost metrics discoverable, and ensure the sidebar scales for Dedicated/Private product tiers.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Navigation hub flows documented in the route map with example URLs for dashboard, rollout detail, model/version pages, cost breakdown, and embeddings explorer.
A2: Figma prototype of primary sidebar + contextual header available with annotated states (collapsed, mobile, workspace-switch open) and keyboard nav interactions.
A3: Quick-switcher prototype returns results in under 200ms in the prototype; supports fuzzy match on workspace name, project, and active routes.
A4: Accessibility review notes included; sidebar and quick-switcher meet keyboard focus order and 4.5:1 contrast requirements.
A5: PM and Eng sign-off recorded, and a tickets list created for engineering handoff (ENG-5071, ENG-5102).
comments: 2026-02-21 - Maya Chen: Kickoff notes added. Ran 6 stakeholder interviews (PM, infra, SRE, two frontend engineers, product marketing). Top themes: users want fewer nested clicks to rollout status and a single place to compare model costs across workspaces.

2026-02-26 - Arjun Patel: Initial IA sketches uploaded to Figma. Two candidate patterns: (A) persistent primary sidebar + contextual horizontal header, (B) condensed hub page with prominent search and cards for Dashboards/Rollouts/Costs. Leaning toward (A) for discoverability.
2026-03-02 - Diego Alvarez (PM): Requested explicit route mapping for Private deployment pages and an affordance for toggling between dedicated/private tenancy contexts.

2026-03-05 - Priya Kapoor (Eng): Feasibility check: the quick-switcher backend will reuse existing workspace index but needs an additional field for 'pinned routes' to return context-specific shortcuts. Raised ENG-5071 for infra work.

2026-03-09 - Design review: Team preferred persistent sidebar + quick-switcher modal. Feedback: add keyboard shortcut cmd/ctrl+K, show last-used routes, and include cost badges next to model cards for quick inspection.

2026-03-11 - Accessibility review (contractor): Focus order on collapsed sidebar fails on mobile -- proposed fix: trap focus in quick-switcher and add aria-expanded states. Marked as must-fix prior to release.
2026-03-12 - Arjun Patel: Updated prototype with keyboard interactions and annotated route map. Requested engineering estimate for rollout toggles and route fallbacks.
2026-03-13 - Diego Alvarez: Reviewed and approved IA for canary experiment. PM asks to split rollout into two engineering tickets: routing changes (ENG-5102) and quick-switcher backend (ENG-5071).
